summary: D-Wave Quantum filed an 8-K reporting a September 10, 2026 prospectus supplement to its January 20, 2026 Form S-3ASR shelf, covering the resale by the United States Department of Commerce of 7,095,721 common shares. Paul, Weiss supplied the Exhibit 5.1 legality opinion and consent. No price, discount, premium, underwriting fee, or closing date is stated; the company receives no proceeds. The filing is a routine shelf takedown/resale registration, not a special situation, though the government-held overhang and any future supply into the market remain the monitoring points.
